name: LaunchLab
description: LaunchLab helps founders deploy GitHub projects with tracking and feedback collection to test product ideas.
descriptionStatus: Confirmed by the founder before service collection.

services.serviceDescription: For founders testing product ideas: deploy a public static HTML or supported Vite/npm GitHub project with tracking and feedback collection, then retrieve measured activity and submitted feedback.
services.serviceGuide: Provide a public GitHub URL, validation goal and target audience. LaunchLab asks for missing details and prepares a plan for approval before deployment. The pilot covers one supported project preview per task. Hosting duration and resource scope must be agreed before launch; hosting does not expire automatically. Share no secrets. Tester recruitment and reward payments are excluded.

nextStep: Await OKX listing review. Marketplace buyer/task binding to the hosted workflow and a complete delivery test remain pending before public operation.
